indication: Symptomatic dermographism inadequately controlled by H1 antihistamines
primary_endpoint: Week 12 complete hive response by Total Fric Score
l1_rationale: Novartis reports Phase III RemIND complete response 29.3% vs 14.0% placebo (p=0.0229); absolute improvement 15.3 percentage points. The approval is known and this is not a blind prediction.
major_risks: Bleeding adverse events and nasopharyngitis reported; verify complete label safety profile and trial subgroup size; application-specific original or amended PDUFA goal missing; FDA signed approval letter October 6; Novartis publicly announced October 7; separate pediatric PMRs 5072-1 and 5072-2
remaining_blocker: FDA action date reconciled to signed October 6 letter; obtain independently verified S-001 goal before promoting lead
